strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Porogarama y'abadandaza bazunguruka na van sales
strings.tierB.home.description: Porogarama y'abakwiragiza ibidandazwa: fagitire n'ivyemezo vy'ukuriha kuri terefone, ibiri mu modoka, ukwishuza, inzira n'ingendo. Ikora ata internet.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Yobora abadandaza bawe bazunguruka kuva ku rugendo rwa mbere gushika ku mafaranga ya nyuma yishujwe
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ni urubuga rwa cloud rugenewe amashirahamwe y'abakwiragiza ibidandazwa n'ay'abaranguza afise abadandaza bazunguruka (commerciaux). Abadandaza batanga kandi bagacapura fagitire n'ivyemezo vy'ukuriha bakoresheje terefone, bagakurikirana ibidandazwa biri mu modoka kandi bakandika ingendo, mu gihe abayobozi babona ako kanya ivyagurishijwe, amafaranga yishujwe n'amadeni y'abakiriya.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Fagitire zivuye kuri terefone y'umudandaza
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Umudandaza atanga fagitire ari ku muryango w'umukiriya, akayicapura kuri printer ya Bluetooth ikoresha ubushuhe (thermique) imbere y'uko ava mu iduka.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Ukwishuza n'amadeni y'abakiriya
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Ukuriha kwose guhabwa icemezo c'ukuriha gifise inomero, gihujwe na fagitire kirihira, kandi ideni ry'umukiriya n'urutonde rwa konte yiwe bihinduka ako kanya.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Ibidandazwa umudandaza ashinzwe mu modoka
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Ibiri mu modoka yose bikurikiranwa kimwe kimwe: ivyapakiwe, ivyagurishijwe, ivyagarutse n'ivyasigaye, ku buryo ikintu cose kibuze kiboneka uwo musi nyene.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Inzira n'ingendo
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Urugendo rwose rwandikwa n'aho rwabereye, isaha n'amafoto, kandi inzira y'umudandaza wese yerekanwa ku ikarata ku muyobozi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Ikora ata internet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Abadandaza babandanya kudandaza ata rezo. Inyandiko zibikwa muri terefone zikarungikwa ubwazo, ata kwisubiramwo, igihe internet igarutse.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Urubuga rw'abayobozi kuri internet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Ivyagurishijwe, ivyishujwe, ivyagarutse, ibiri mu bubiko n'ibikorwa vy'abadandaza ahantu hamwe, hamwe n'uruhara n'uburenganzira vy'umuntu wese akoresha porogarama.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tubwire ingene udandaza
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Saba proforma canke utegure inama natwe. Tuzoraba abadandaza bawe, inzira zawe, ibidandazwa vyawe n'ivyo ukeneye kuri fagitire.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Tegura ishirahamwe ryawe muri FieldSales
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Shiramwo ibidandazwa, ibiciro vyavyo, abakiriya n'abadandaza, kandi ushire mu mahitamwo (paramètres) ifaranga n'urugero rw'ikori vy'igihugu cawe.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Rungika abadandaza mu kazi
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Abadandaza bashira porogarama kuri Android canke iPhone, bagapakira imodoka bagatangura kudandaza, gucapura no kwishuza.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Kurikirana umusi uko ugenda
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Urubuga rw'abayobozi rwerekana ivyagurishijwe, ivyishujwe, ibiri mu modoka n'ingendo, mu gihe abadandaza bakiri mu nzira.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ni urubuga rwa cloud rwo kuyobora abadandaza bazunguruka mu mashirahamwe y'abakwiragiza ibidandazwa n'ay'abaranguza. Irimwo van sales (kudandariza mu modoka), route sales (kudandaza ku nzira zizwi), pre-sales (kwakira komande imbere) na DSD (gushikiriza ibidandazwa ku iduka ata wundi hagati). Abadandaza batanga fagitire, bagacapura, bakishuza kandi bakandika ingendo kuri terefone, naho abayobozi bagakurikirana ivyagurishijwe, ivyishujwe, ibiri mu modoka n'amadeni y'abakiriya ku rubuga rwabo kuri internet.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Ego. Porogarama y'umudandaza ibandanya gukora ata internet: umudandaza atanga kandi agacapura fagitire n'ivyemezo vy'ukuriha, akandika ingendo kandi akongeramwo abakiriya, maze vyose bikarungikwa ubwavyo ata kwisubiramwo igihe internet igarutse. Hari ikintu kimwe kidasanzwe muri Arabiya Sawudite: amashirahamwe ahujwe n'uburyo bwa fagitire za elegitoronike akenera internet igihe fagitire canke iy'ivyagarutse itangwa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales ikorera amashirahamwe akwiragiza ibidandazwa mu bihugu vyose. Ishirahamwe ryose rishira ifaranga ryaryo n'urugero rw'ikori mu mahitamwo yaryo, kandi fagitire, ivyemezo vy'ukuriha na raporo birabikoresha. Icicaro ca FieldSales kiri i Riyadh muri Arabiya Sawudite, kandi tugufasha gutangura kuri internet biciye mu nama, kuri WhatsApp n'imfashanyo ya kure.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales irahuzwa n'uburyo bwa Leta bwa fagitire za elegitoronike?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Turashigikira uguhuzwa n'urubuga Fatoora rwa ZATCA mu ntambwe ya kabiri. Ivyo vyerekeye amashirahamwe ari muri Arabiya Sawudite. Mu bindi bihugu, harimwo n'Uburundi, FieldSales itanga fagitire zifise ifaranga ryawe n'urugero rwawe rw'ikori, kandi guhuzwa n'uburyo bw'igihugu bwa fagitire za elegitoronike biraboneka ubisavye, inyuma yo gusuzuma hamwe nawe ivyo ico gihugu gisaba. Hanze ya Arabiya Sawudite ntidusezerana ko fagitire zizohura n'ivyo igihugu ico ari co cose gisaba.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Porogarama ya FieldSales iboneka mu zihe ndimi?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Isura ya porogarama ya FieldSales (interface) iboneka mu ndimi zikurikira gusa: Icarabu, Icongereza, Igifaransa, Igiturukiya n'Igishinwa. Ntiboneka mu Kirundi. Abadandaza n'abayobozi barashobora guhindura ururimi rw'isura, kandi fagitire zicapuwe zirashobora kugira ururimi rwa kabiri iruhande rw'ururimi nyamukuru. Impapuro z'urubuga mu zindi ndimi, harimwo n'uru rupapuro rw'Ikirundi, ni ubuhinduzi bugenewe gutanga amakuru kuri FieldSales.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Saba proforma, utegure inama canke utwandikire kuri WhatsApp. Turiga ingene abadandaza bawe bakora, hanyuma tukagufasha gushiramwo ibidandazwa, ibiciro vyavyo, abakiriya n'abadandaza. Abadandaza bashira porogarama kuri Android canke iPhone, naho abayobozi bagakoresha urubuga rwabo muri navigateur iyo ari yo yose. Smartphone ni vyo bikoresho vyonyene ukeneye.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Isura ya porogarama ya FieldSales iboneka mu ndimi zikurikira: Icarabu, Icongereza, Igifaransa, Igiturukiya n'Igishinwa. Ntiboneka mu Kirundi. Impapuro ziri mu zindi ndimi zisigura FieldSales ku bw'amakuru gusa.
strings.tierB.category.title: Van sales: porogarama yo kudandariza mu modoka | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Porogarama ya van sales na route sales: fagitire zicapurwa zivuye kuri terefone, ibiri mu modoka kimwe kimwe, ukwishuza n'ingendo. Ikora ata internet.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Porogarama ya van sales (kudandariza mu modoka) ku bakwiragiza ibidandazwa n'abaranguza
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ni porogarama ya van sales igenewe amashirahamwe afise abadandaza badandariza mu modoka ku nzira zabo imisi yose. Umudandaza apakira imodoka, agadandaza ku iduka ryose, agacapura fagitire, akishuza kandi akandika ivyagarutse akoresheje porogarama imwe kuri terefone. Umuyobozi abona ivyapakiwe, ivyagurishijwe, ivyishujwe n'ivyasigaye mu modoka yose.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Porogarama ya van sales ni iki?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Porogarama ya van sales, yitwa kandi cash van canke route sales, ikoreshwa mu buryo bwo kudandaza aho umudandaza atwara ibidandazwa mu modoka akagurisha, akabishikiriza, agatanga fagitire kandi akishuza mu rugendo rumwe. Isubirira ibitabu vya fagitire vy'impapuro n'uguhamagarana kuri terefone ku mugoroba. Yandika ukugurisha kwose, ukuriha kwose n'ikidandazwa cose cagarutse nk'inyandiko, ku buryo ibidandazwa n'amafaranga bigereranywa uwo musi nyene. Ku muyobozi, yishura ibibazo bitatu imigoroba yose: umudandaza wese yagurishije iki, yishuje angahe, kandi ni iki gisigaye mu modoka yose.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Umusi umwe mu kazi ko hanze
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Umusi utangurira ku gupakira imodoka ibidandazwa bivuye mu bubiko, vyose vyanditswe. Ku iduka ryose, umudandaza ahitamwo umukiriya muri porogarama, akongeramwo ibidandazwa akoresheje urutonde canke barcode, agatanga fagitire akayicapura kuri printer ikoresha ubushuhe. Ukuriha kwandikwa n'icemezo c'ukuriha, kandi ikidandazwa cose cagarutse candikwa n'imvo yaco. Ku mugoroba, ivyasigaye mu modoka bisubizwa mu bubiko. Hagati y'izo ntambwe, umuyobozi arashobora gukurikirana ivyagurishijwe, ivyishujwe n'ingendo vy'umudandaza wese ku rubuga rw'abayobozi, ata n'umwe ahamagaye.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Yubakiwe ahantu rezo iri nke
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Inzira zo gukwiragiza ibidandazwa zica mu nsi y'inyubakwa, mu turere tw'inganda no mu misozi ya kure ifise rezo nke. Porogarama y'umudandaza ya FieldSales ibika abakiriya, ibidandazwa n'ibiciro vyavyo muri terefone, ku buryo umudandaza ashobora gutanga no gucapura inyandiko ata internet. Inyandiko yose ifise ikimenyetso cayo kidasa n'ikindi, gutyo ishika kuri seriveri rimwe gusa, naho yorungikwa incuro zirenze imwe. Amashirahamwe yo muri Arabiya Sawudite ahujwe n'uburyo bwa fagitire za elegitoronike akenera internet igihe fagitire n'iz'ivyagarutse zitangwa. Ivyemezo vy'ukuriha, ingendo n'abakiriya bashasha vyo bibandanya gukora ata internet.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Ukwishuza n'ibiri mu modoka
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Amafaranga atwarwa mu nzira akeneye ukugenzurwa nk'ibidandazwa. Amafaranga yose yishujwe ahabwa icemezo c'ukuriha gifise inomero gishobora guhuzwa na fagitire kirihira, kandi ideni ry'umukiriya rihinduka ako kanya. Ibiri mu modoka biharurwa ku kidandazwa cose: ivyapakiwe ukuyemwo ivyagurishijwe, wongeyeko ivyagarutse n'amahinduka yanditswe, ku buryo abayobozi babigereranya n'iharura nyaryo imbere y'uko umudandaza ataha. Ivyagarutse birashobora gushirwa mu bice bitatu: bisanzwe, vyononekaye canke vyo guhinduranya, kandi umuyobozi ni we yemeza nimba bisubira mu bidandazwa bigurishwa biri mu modoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Igenewe nde?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales ibereye abakwiragiza n'abaranguza b'ibidandazwa bigurishwa vuba nk'ibifungurwa, ibinyobwa, ibikoresho vy'isuku n'ivyo kwitunganya, n'ishirahamwe iryo ari ryo ryose rifise abadandaza bagendera amaduka ku nzira. Ishigikira van sales, komande za pre-sales na DSD (gushikiriza ibidandazwa ku iduka ata wundi hagati). Si ERP yuzuye: ihuzwa n'uburyo bwawe bw'ibiharuro (comptabilité) canke ERP biciye kuri API. Abayobozi bagena ivyo umudandaza wese yemerewe gukora, nko gutanga igabanuka ry'igiciro, kugurisha munsi y'igiciro c'urutonde canke kwongeramwo abakiriya bashasha.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Ni irihe tandukaniro riri hagati ya van sales na pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Muri van sales, umudandaza atwara ibidandazwa akabishikiriza, agatanga fagitire kandi akishuza mu rugendo rumwe. Muri pre-sales, umudandaza yakira komande, ububiko bukazoyishikiriza mu nyuma. FieldSales ishigikira ubwo buryo bwompi, ku buryo ishirahamwe rishobora gukoresha cash van ku nzira zimwe no kwakira komande ku zindi. Muri ubwo buryo bwompi, fagitire, ivyishujwe n'amadeni y'abakiriya biba muri porogarama imwe, kandi abayobozi babibona vyose hamwe muri raporo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Nohuza gute konte y'imodoka ku mugoroba?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales yerekana, ku kidandazwa cose mu modoka yose, igitigiri capakiwe, cagurishijwe, cagarutse n'icasigaye. Gereranya igitigiri casigaye n'iharura nyaryo, wandike itandukaniro nk'ihinduka ryanditswe, hanyuma usubize ivyasigaye mu bubiko mu gikorwa kimwe. Imodoka itangura umusi ukurikira ifise konte itomoye kandi izwi.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Umudandaza wa van sales akenera ibihe bikoresho?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone ya Android canke iPhone. Printer ya Bluetooth ikoresha ubushuhe si itegeko, ariko ifasha umudandaza guha umukiriya fagitire canke icemezo c'ukuriha gicapuwe. FieldSales ntigurisha ibikoresho kandi ntigusaba gukoresha ubwoko bumwe gusa bwa printer. Abayobozi bakoresha urubuga rwabo muri navigateur ya mudasobwa (ordinateur) canke terefone iyo ari yo yose.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales irashobora guhuzwa n'uburyo bwacu bw'ibiharuro?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Ego. FieldSales itanga API ituma uburyo bwawe bw'ibiharuro (comptabilité) canke ERP buhanahana n'urubuga abakiriya, ibidandazwa, fagitire, ivyemezo vy'ukuriha n'ivyimurwa vy'ububiko. Umugwi wawe canke uwo mukorana mu vy'ubuhinga ni we ahuza ivyo vyompi akoresheje inyandiko zisigura API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales mu bihugu: ifaranga, ikori na e-facture
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales ikorera abakwiragiza ibidandazwa mu bihugu vyose. Raba mu rutonde ifaranga, ikori n'ingene fagitire za elegitoronike zihagaze mu gihugu cose.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales ikorera amashirahamwe akwiragiza ibidandazwa mu bihugu vyose. Ishirahamwe ryose rihitamwo igihugu caryo, ifaranga n'urugero rw'ikori mu mahitamwo yaryo, kandi fagitire, ivyemezo vy'ukuriha na raporo bikurikiza ivyo. Guhuzwa n'uburyo bwa Leta bwa fagitire za elegitoronike birakora muri Arabiya Sawudite gusa. Mu bindi bihugu vyose biraboneka ubisavye. Urutonde rukurikira rwerekana, ku gihugu cose, ifaranga rihakoreshwa, urugero rusanzwe rw'ikori ku kugurisha canke TVA, na nimba guhuzwa n'uburyo bwa Leta bwa fagitire za elegitoronike birakora canke biraboneka ubisavye.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Turashigikira uguhuzwa n'urubuga Fatoora rwa ZATCA mu ntambwe ya kabiri
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Ifaranga n'urugero rw'ikori bishirwaho n'ishirahamwe ryose mu mahitamwo yaryo bwite. Ingero ziri muri uru rutonde zigufasha gusa kumenya muri rusangi, kandi zirashobora guhinduka; banza wemeze amategeko ariho n'umujanama wawe mu vy'amakori. Akarongo (—) gasigura ko nta rugero rusangi rwanditswe kuri ico gihugu.
strings.tierB.about.title: Ibijanye na FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales, yashinzwe mu 2026 i Riyadh (Arabiya Sawudite), ikora porogarama za cloud ku mashirahamwe akwiragiza ibidandazwa afise abadandaza bazunguruka.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (izina mu Carabu: فيلد سيلز) ni urubuga rwa cloud rugenewe amashirahamwe y'abakwiragiza ibidandazwa n'ay'abaranguza afise abadandaza bazunguruka. FieldSales yashinzwe mu 2026 kandi ifise icicaro i Riyadh muri Arabiya Sawudite. Ikorera amashirahamwe yo mu bihugu vyose, kandi ishirahamwe ryose rishira ifaranga n'urugero rw'ikori vy'igihugu caryo mu mahitamwo yaryo bwite. Abakiriya bacu ni amashirahamwe agurisha kandi agashikiriza ibidandazwa biciye ku badandaza bari mu nzira: abakwiragiza, abaranguza n'inganda zifise imodoka zazo zo kudandaza.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Twubaka uburyo bumwe buhuza ibice vyose vy'akazi ko hanze: fagitire zicapurwa zivuye kuri terefone y'umudandaza, ivyemezo vy'ukuriha n'amadeni y'abakiriya, ibidandazwa umudandaza ashinzwe mu modoka, inzira n'ingendo bifise aho vyabereye n'amafoto, n'urubuga rw'abayobozi kuri internet. Porogarama y'umudandaza ikora kuri Android no kuri iPhone kandi ibandanya gukora ata internet, hanyuma igahuza amakuru igihe internet igarutse. Amashirahamwe arashobora guhuza FieldSales n'uburyo bwayo bw'ibiharuro canke ERP biciye kuri API, ku buryo amakuru ava mu kazi ko hanze adakenera kwandikwa kabiri.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Tuvuga ivyerekeye porogarama yacu uko biri. Turashigikira uguhuzwa n'urubuga Fatoora rwa ZATCA mu ntambwe ya kabiri. Mu bindi bihugu, guhuzwa n'uburyo bwa Leta biraboneka ubisavye. Isura ya porogarama iboneka mu ndimi zikurikira: Icarabu, Icongereza, Igifaransa, Igiturukiya n'Igishinwa. Ntiboneka mu Kirundi. Kugira tuvugane, saba proforma, utegure inama canke utwandikire kuri WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Vugana na FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Vugana n'umugwi wa FieldSales: saba proforma, utegure inama canke utwandikire kuri WhatsApp ku bijanye na porogarama y'abadandaza bazunguruka na van sales.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tubwire ingene abadandaza bawe badandaza ubu n'ivyo wipfuza guhindura. Saba proforma, utegure inama canke utwandikire kuri WhatsApp, maze umwe mu bagize umugwi wacu akwishure. Abakiriya basanzwe bakeneye gufashwa barashobora gukoresha izo nzira nyene. Biradufasha iyo uvuze igihugu cawe, igitigiri c'abadandaza bawe na nimba badandariza mu modoka, bakira komande canke bakora vyompi.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Tegura inama kuri internet n'umugwi wacu. Tuzokwereka umusi w'umudandaza muri porogarama n'urubuga rw'umuyobozi, dukoresheje uturorero twegereye ibidandazwa vyawe n'inzira zawe, kandi tuzokwishura ibibazo vyawe ku bijanye no gutegura porogarama.
